literal: Mind to the pure ones, legacy good will become; company to the pure ones, there is not good not-becoming action.
translation: For those of pure mind, their legacy will be good. For those of pure company, there is no deed that does not turn out good.
modern: மனம் தூய்மையாக உள்ளவர்களுக்கு அவர்கள் விட்டுச்செல்லும் சந்ததியும் நன்மையாக அமையும். சேரும் இனம் தூய்மையாக உள்ளவர்களுக்கு நன்மையாக முடியாத செயல் என்று எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet compares the benefits of a pure mind with those of pure company. The word 'eccam' literally means 'what is left behind', which in this context refers to one's offspring or legacy; for those with a pure mind, this legacy will be good. However, the couplet emphasizes the greater power of good company by stating that for those whose associations are pure, absolutely no action will fail to produce good results. While mental purity secures what follows in the future, pure company guarantees goodness and success in every present deed.
